escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6
escalations.description: Remote attacker can bypass IP-based access controls by crafting IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Affects authentication and routing trust.
escalations.fix: npm update proxy-addr to 2.0.8+ in all three affected projects

escalations.title: protobufjs Code Injection via bytes field defaults (RCE)
escalations.description: Arbitrary code injection via bytes field defaults in generated toObject() methods. RCE risk in gRPC serialization path.

escalations.title: handlebars Template Injection → RCE via AST Confusion
escalations.description: Tampering with @partial-block causes AST type confusion, allowing arbitrary code execution. Template injection vector.

escalations.title: tinypool Prototype Pollution → RCE in Worker Threads
escalations.description: Worker options lack validation; prototype pollution leads to arbitrary code execution in worker threads. Transitive via vitest/vite-node.
escalations.fix: npm update tinypool vitest vite-node to vitest 3.0.5+

escalations.title: vitest Arbitrary File Read when UI Server Listening
escalations.description: Vitest UI server (--ui flag) exposes filesystem for arbitrary read and execution. Critical if UI server accidentally exposed on shared network.
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to 3.0.5+, ensure --ui never used in production or CI-exposed environments
escalations.trigger: sensitive data exposed / arbitrary file read

findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blindspot — 84% of Requirements Unverified
findings.description: Mandatory gate exits 0 by auto-selecting Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs). Never scans Specifications/ which defines ~77 additional requirements. All teams pass the gate with false confidence.
findings.recommendation: Add second enforcer pass against Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md and Specifications/workflow-engine.md. Run with --fail-on-missing-ids for the latter.

findings.title: OpenTelemetry Absent — Non-Negotiable Architecture Rule Violated
findings.description: Zero @opentelemetry/* packages in Source/. Logger writes plain JSON with no trace/span IDs. No middleware injects or propagates W3C traceparent header. CLAUDE.md and FR-021 declare OTel non-negotiable.
findings.recommendation: Install @opentelemetry/sdk-node, @opentelemetry/api, auto-instrumentation middleware. Inject trace/span IDs into all log lines. Propagate traceparent header across service boundaries.

findings.title: blocked_by missing from UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput
findings.description: FR-dependency-api-types not satisfied. The blocked_by field is absent from update input types.
findings.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput in portal/Shared/api.ts

findings.title: Dependency seed data missing — portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts absent
findings.description: FR-dependency-seed not satisfied. No seed data for dependency relationships exists.
findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with sample dependency data for development and testing.

findings.title: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx absent
findings.description: FR-dependency-frontend-tests not satisfied. Two required test files are missing.
findings.recommendation: Create DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx with unit tests covering dependency display and blocking states.

findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts — 3 of 4 required metrics absent
findings.description: FR metrics require a dependencyCheckDuration histogram. At least 3 of 4 required metrics are not present.
findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDuration Histogram and remaining required metrics to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts

findings.title: Dependency feature diverging metric coverage across Source/ and portal/
findings.description: Dependency feature implemented in both Source/ and portal/ with inconsistent metric coverage, creating maintenance divergence.
findings.recommendation: Align metric coverage between Source/Backend and portal/Backend dependency service implementations.

findings.title: body-parser DoS via invalid limit (GHSA-1123977)
findings.description: Invalid limit parameter causes silent enforcement bypass, potential DoS.
findings.recommendation: npm update body-parser to 1.20.9+

findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS in route pattern matching (GHSA-1119740)
findings.description: Unbounded backtracking in route pattern matching allows ReDoS attacks.
findings.recommendation: npm update path-to-regexp to patched version

findings.title: react-router Open Redirect (GHSA-1193669)
findings.description: react-router and react-router-dom contain an open redirect vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Update react-router-dom to 7.0+ (breaking change — coordinate with frontend team)

findings.title: ws Path Traversal and DoS (GHSA-1162899/1193318)
findings.description: WebSocket library has path traversal and DoS vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: npm update ws to patched version

findings.title: js-yaml Quadratic-Complexity DoS in merge key handling (GHSA-1121859)
findings.description: Specially crafted YAML with merge keys causes quadratic time complexity and OOM.
findings.recommendation: npm update js-yaml to 3.15.2+

findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection in multipart field names (GHSA-1120743)
findings.description: CRLF injection via multipart field names could allow header injection attacks.
findings.recommendation: npm update form-data to patched version

findings.title: Logger always emits JSON — no NODE_ENV pretty-print for dev
findings.description: CLAUDE.md requires pretty-printing in development mode. Logger always uses JSON regardless of NODE_ENV.
findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV check to switch to pino-pretty or equivalent in development.

findings.title: Duplicate logger abstraction — shim with incompatible call signature
findings.description: Two logger files with different call signatures create confusion and maintenance overhead.
findings.recommendation: Delete shim file src/logger.ts and update all imports to point to src/utils/logger.ts directly.

findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without explanation
findings.description: Silencing a React hooks rule without explanation is a code smell and potential source of stale closure bugs.
findings.recommendation: Add an inline comment explaining why the dep is intentionally excluded, or fix the hook to include the dependency.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer regex over-matches seed data IDs — 7 false failures
findings.description: Regex matches FR IDs in seed data files, producing 7 false failures on the dependency-linking plan.
findings.recommendation: Narrow regex to match only // Verifies: FR-XXX comment pattern, excluding data files.

findings.title: 60+ Medium CVEs in build/test/observability transitive dependencies
findings.description: Medium-severity CVEs in brace-expansion, browserslist, postcss, source-map-js, nanoid, and @opentelemetry/* packages. Lower risk as most are in test/build tools.
findings.recommendation: Schedule quarterly dependency update pass. Prioritize nanoid (insufficient entropy) and postcss.

findings.title: Major version lag — react v18→19, express v4→5, react-router v6→7
findings.description: Core dependencies are 1+ major versions behind. Some require architectural changes (react-router v7 API changes).
findings.recommendation: Plan major version upgrades as a coordinated sprint. Start with react-router v7 (security benefit) then react v19.

findings.title: Specifications/workflow-engine.md has zero FR IDs — canonical spec is untraceable
findings.description: The workflow engine spec has no FR-XXX requirement IDs, making it impossible to trace implementation back to this spec.
findings.recommendation: Assign FR IDs to all requirements in Specifications/workflow-engine.md.
